It relies upon its link to the tower—its body, effectively— to see or interact with the world. Named Zbnik (“Wildcat”) by its original Zandian owners, it was here that the Titans stopped the Zandians’ terrorist activities. They agreed to Checkmate renovating it for Titans’ use dur - ing the team’s time working with the government.
